description: Mathematical and formal reasoning with OpenAI's thinking tier (high reasoning effort). Use for proofs, derivations, and problems where a wrong step invalidates the answer. Put your QUERY in the 'query' parameter.

context.description: Additional context for the reasoning task

files.description: File paths to read as code context. Supports line ranges: 'src/foo.ts:100-200'. Model sees ACTUAL CODE.

mode.description: Reasoning mode (e.g., mathematical, scientific, logical, analytical)

query.description: The question or problem to reason about (REQUIRED - put your question here)

name: openai_reason
